svg.title: Suffix Array + Kasai's O(n) LCP and Manacher's Linear Palindrome Mirror
svg.desc: Dual-panel animated diagram: Left panel shows Suffix Array SA = [6, 5, 3, 1, 0, 4, 2] for "banana$" and Kasai's O(n) LCP invariant h = max(0, h - 1) transitioning from suffix i=1 (anana$) to i=2 (nana$); Right panel shows Manacher's #-padded palindrome array #c#b#a#b#a#b#d# animating the [C, R] bracket, mirror lookup i' = 2C - i, and boundary expansion.
svg.text: Suffix Array + Kasai's O(n) LCP & Manacher's Linear Palindromes
Left: Kasai's h = max(0, h - 1) text-order sweep avoids quadratic re-checks; Right: Manacher's #-padding and [C, R] mirror symmetry
1. Suffix Array & Kasai's LCP on S = "banana$"

g.text: Kasai's Text-Order Invariant: h = max(0, h - 1)
1. Process suffixes in text order i = 0 .. n-1 (via rank[i]).
2. h decrements at most n times; h <= n => increments <= 2n.
Result: LCP = [0, 1, 3, 0, 0, 2] built in strictly O(n) time.
If i < R: P[i] = min(R - i, P[2*C - i])
Expand: while (S[i - 1 - P[i]] == S[i + 1 + P[i]]) P[i]++
If i + P[i] > R: C = i; R = i + P[i] (R advances => O(n))
1. At i=7 ('b'), C=5, R=8: mirror i'=3 (P[3]=1); expands R->12!
Max radius P[7] = 5 => longest palindrome "babab" in O(n) time.
